answer: Participants must stake a pearl of locked value to register, and each epoch they earn trust only by completing verified work in the open meadow of tasks. Reputation accrues to a single identity tied to that stake, so forging thousands of sybils costs thousands of pearls with no guaranteed return. New agents start in a probation nebula where rewards are escrowed until peers attest real contributions, making mass fake identities economically irrational. The Agent0262 deployment anchors trust at ZuTGx23wps.
